methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The primary aim of this paper is to group the EU member states into clusters based on six key energy performance indicators: primary energy consumption, energy productivity, renewable energy in transport, renewable energy in electricity, and renewable energy in heating and cooling.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Energy performance indicators appear only as externally defined national Eurostat macro-indicators used as inputs to a two-step cluster analysis (TSCA) and PROMETHEE MCDM ranking of EU member states. The paper presents no EnPI/EnB measurement model to identify or characterise, and has no organisational dimension (national energy-policy comparison).

paper_type.evidence_quote: This paper employs two-step cluster analysis using IBM SPSS 26.0 to classify EU member states based on six key energy indicators.

stage1.notes: Macro/national energy-policy clustering study (EU-27, Eurostat indicators) via two-step cluster analysis + PROMETHEE MCDM. EnPIs are inputs, not a constructed or characterised EnPI/EnB model; no organisational dimension. Ineligible under v2.3 (incidental EnPI mention; government-policy focus).
